description: The daily security-only run (#79). The renovate job in .gitlab-ci.yml reads this file on top of renovate.json, as RENOVATE_ADDITIONAL_CONFIG_FILE, only when the pipeline schedule sets RENOVATE_SECURITY_ONLY=true. Everything else -- managers, lookups, groups, the GOPROXY rule -- comes from renovate.json, so there is one place to change it; this file only turns ordinary updates off.

The shape is Renovate's own security:only-security-updates preset at the pinned 44.83.2: one package rule matching every package with enabled false, vulnerabilityAlerts enabled, and osvVulnerabilityAlerts on. A fix for an OSV advisory still opens, because Renovate appends its vulnerability rules after every configured one and forces vulnerabilityAlerts' settings over them.

Renovate merges the repository's own renovate.json after this, appending its packageRules. None of those sets enabled to true; one that did, for a broad match, would turn ordinary updates back on in this run.

packageRules.description: Every ordinary update is off in this run; only vulnerability fixes, which override this, open merge requests.
